title: TML Interaction Models: Real-time Multimodal AI
summary: A new class of AI systems by Thinking Machines Lab designed for native, real-time multimodal interaction. Utilizing a micro-turn architecture, the models process audio, video, and text in 200-millisecond chunks, allowing for simultaneous perception and response.
research_notes: Founded by Mira Murati and Soumith Chintala; the TML-Interaction-Small model uses a Mixture-of-Experts architecture with 276 billion parameters.

evolution.summary: The project introduced a dual-model system where a fast interaction model handles live conversation while an asynchronous background model manages complex reasoning; currently in research preview for partners.
